scope: Completed diagnostic captures01..11 only; no production or hardware changes
raw_amplitude_scope: Bounded first-parity representative records, not an unbiased noise/offset sample set

first_capture_amplitude_interpretation.interpretation: Hundreds of thousands of uncalibrated raw codes on shorted AA inputs are compatible with the documented offset plus high-data-rate noise. These bounded parity-selected records do not establish precision, full-group noise distribution, or a sample timing defect. No offset fitting or threshold change follows.

first_capture_status_and_freshness.interpretation: START command execution overlaps conversion start, so call plus following wait is compatible with first-conversion timing. ISR generation and software times are not physical edge timestamps. Continuous groups may see multiple new DRDY edges during a read without making a command-mode holding-register result intrinsically stale.
first_capture_status_and_freshness.continuous_pulse_comparison_limit: RUNMODE, START cadence, held reads, and overall transfer phase differ; 9/4400 versus 0/4400 alone is not causal proof or an infinite-error-free claim.
